_comment: GAO Agent — Context7 MCP Config for Windsurf
Running in LOCAL mode (no API key required for basic usage)
1. Open Windsurf > Customizations (hammer icon) > MCP config
2. Merge this config into your existing MCP configuration
3. Refresh MCP servers or restart Windsurf to activate
To get higher rate limits, add your API key from https://context7.com/dashboard :
